scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run desktop:install && npm run build && npm run build:desktop-runtime
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --projectDir desktop --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --projectDir desktop --mac -c.mac.identity=null --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:mac:signed: npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --projectDir desktop --mac --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --projectDir desktop --win --publish never
